notes: Added missing contract definition, core enforcement logic, API surface integration, and positive-path validation coverage.

GPTR-F-001-S79.title: Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S79.description: Define a strict allowlist contract specifying permitted collections, query operators, filter fields, projection limits, and max result size. Store as a centralized schema used by the enforcement layer.

GPTR-F-001-S80.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S80.description: Implement server-side enforcement logic that evaluates every incoming request against the allowlist contract, rejecting any request with unauthorized collections, fields, operators, or excessive limits before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S81.title: Azure Function Endpoint Enforcement Integration
GPTR-F-001-S81.description: Integrate the enforcement engine into the Azure Function entry point to guarantee all inbound GPTReader requests are validated prior to any data access or query execution.

GPTR-F-001-S82.title: Standardized Rejection and Audit Logging
GPTR-F-001-S82.description: Implement consistent rejection responses for blocked requests and log all enforcement failures with metadata (request type, violation reason, caller identity) for audit and security monitoring.

GPTR-F-001-S83.title: Positive Path Validation and Performance Tests
GPTR-F-001-S83.description: Create test cases validating that compliant requests pass enforcement correctly and measure latency overhead introduced by enforcement to ensure it stays within acceptable bounds.

GPTR-F-001.mitigation: Strict schema validation + centralized allowlist + mandatory enforcement at entry point
